transcript: Speaker A: अरे दिखाई नहीं देता क्या? अंधे हो? [Can't you see? Are you blind?] Speaker B: Yes, I am blind... Speaker A: Oh, sorry भाई। [Oh, sorry brother.] Speaker B: अरे भाई sorry, ये एक prank था। [Sorry brother, it was a prank.] Speaker A: इतनी अच्छी English कहाँ से सीखी? [Where did you learn such good English?] Speaker B: English Seekho app से। [From English Seekho app.] Speaker A: English Seekho app? ये क्या है? [What is that?] Speaker B: [Explains app features like basic to advanced lessons and AI coach for fluent English practice.] Speaker A: थैंक्स, मैं अभी download करता हूँ। [Thanks, downloading now.] Voiceover: तो install button पे click करो और English Seekho app download करो। [Click install to download English Seekho.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand, and is for educational purposes only.]
summary: A street prank skit transitions into a promotion for the 'English Seekho' app. One actor explains how the app's step-by-step lessons and AI coach helped him speak fluent English, concluding with a call to install the app.
